prompt: Implement a modular Enterprise Blockchain Ledger in C# with three isolated modules: (1) Transaction Pool managing cryptographic signatures and unspent output verification, (2) Block Miner executing proof-of-work hashing puzzles, and (3) Chain Validator verifying cryptographic hash linking across blocks.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Pool Score: 0-5 (Evaluates signature verification and transaction integrity)
Module 2 Miner Score: 0-5 (Evaluates proof-of-work difficulty targeting and hashing loop)
Module 3 Validator Score: 0-5 (Evaluates immutable chain linkage verification)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates consensus and ledger consistency)
